1 Fills.
2 Stimulates.
3 Defends.

Counteracts the ageing process. For visibly smoother, radiant, and younger looking skin.</div><span class="legal-label cp-text-s">NART: 63486-09910-22</span></div><div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Read more about our product</p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text">Anti-ageing night cream for all skin types As we age, our skin’s own production of Hyaluronic Acid decreases causing the skin to form <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/wrinkles" target="">wrinkles</a> and look older. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Night with 3x Effect formula counteracts this process: Fills: High and low molecular acid moisturizes and plumps up <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/wrinkles" target="">wrinkles</a>. Stimulates: The anti-oxidant, Saponin, activates the skin’s own Hyaluronic Acid production by up to 256% and protects the skin from <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/free-radicals" target="">free radicals</a>. Defends: <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/our-research/ingredients/e/enoxolone" target="">Enoxolone</a> decreases the degradation rate of Hyaluronic-Acid by more than 50%. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Night addresses the first signs of ageing. It noticeably plumps up <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/wrinkles" target="">fine lines</a> and even deep <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/wrinkles" target="">wrinkles</a> for a rejuvenated look while supporting skin regeneration. Eucerin’s unique blend of high and low molecular Hyaluronic Acid, <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/our-research/ingredients/g/glycine" target="">Glycine</a>-saponin, and <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/our-research/ingredients/e/enoxolone" target="">Enoxolone</a> delivers a targeted approach to visibly plumping even deep <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/wrinkles" target="">wrinkles</a>. High molecular Hyaluronic Acid improves hydration and smooths the outermost layers of skin while low molecular Hyaluronic Acid, which is 40 times smaller(1), penetrates further into the epidermal skin layers where deeper <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/wrinkles" target="">wrinkles</a> originate. The anti-oxidant, <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/our-research/ingredients/g/glycine" target="">Glycine</a> Saponin, supports Hyaluronic Acid production in the dermal layer where the deepest <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/wrinkles" target="">wrinkles</a> are formed and protects from <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/free-radicals" target="">free radicals</a>. <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/our-research/ingredients/e/enoxolone" target="">Enoxolone</a> protects the skin’s own Hyaluron from degradation and <a href="https://www.eucerin.co.uk/our-research/ingredients/d/dexpanthenol" target="">Dexpanthenol</a> supports skin’s overnight regeneration process. <strong><span style="color: #999999;">The Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler range has been specially formulated to tackle the first signs of ageing such as fine lines and wrinkles. </span></strong><span style="text-align: start; color: #999999;">While our skin is as individual as we are, and skin ages differently depending on our genetics and lifestyle, these normally start to appear around the age of 30. The products in the Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler range work to counteract the ageing process by plumping up deep wrinkles. For visibly smoother, radiant, and younger looking skin.</span><span style="color: #999999;"><br style="text-align: start;" />
<br style="text-align: start;" />
<span style="text-align: start;">If a loss of volume is your primary concern (as is often the case between the ages of 40 and 50), then the</span></span><a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/products/hyaluron-filler-plus-volume-lift" style="text-align: start;"> Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Volume-Lift range</a><span style="text-align: start; color: #999999;"> has been specially formulated to plump up deep wrinkles and redefine facial contours for a lifting effect. If skin elasticity and deepening wrinkles are your primary concern (most common for those over 50) then we recommend the </span><a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/products/hyaluron-filler-plus-elasticity" style="text-align: start;">Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity range</a><span style="text-align: start; color: #999999;">.</span><span style="color: #999999;"><br style="text-align: start;" />
<br style="text-align: start;" />
<span style="text-align: start;">For more information on the different stages of </span></span><a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/skin-concerns/ageing-skin/in-general" style="text-align: start;">skin ageing</a><span style="text-align: start; color: #999999;">, and to help you find the right product for you, read our </span><a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/about-skin/basic-skin-knowledge/skin-in-different-ages" style="text-align: start;">article on facial skin at different ages</a><span style="text-align: start; color: #999999;">.</span>
<p> </p></div></div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>At what age should I start using Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler?</p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p><span style="color: #999999;">Our skin is as different as we are, so the answer to that question varies from person to person and depends on many factors both internal (such as our genetics) and external (such as the amount of sun our skin has been exposed to).</span><strong style="color: #999999;"> As a general rule, the first signs of aging such as fine lines and wrinkles start to appear in our 30s and that is when we recommend you start using the <a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/products/hyaluron-filler">Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler range</a>. </strong><span style="background-color: #f9f9f9; color: #999999;">If you are in any doubt please </span><a href="/sitecore/content/legacy/eucerin/home/about-skin/basic-skin-knowledge/skin-in-different-ages">read our article on facial skin at different ages</a><span style="color: #999999;"> or consult a pharmacist or dermatologist.</span></p></div></div><div class="accordion-jss"><div class="accordion-jss__title cp-text" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-content"><p>Why do I need a night cream?</p><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M19.6363 15.8181L11.9999 8.18175L4.36353 15.8181" stroke="#222222"></path></svg></div><div id="accordion-content" class="accordion-jss__content cp-text"><p style="color: #999999;">Skin regenerates overnight. As well as moisturising skin, night creams contain ingredients that stimulate the cell regeneration process. In Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler Night that active ingredient is Dexpanthenol which supports skin’s regeneration process overnight. <br />
<strong>
